title: Your Turn: Stop Being the Cron Job
text: Nothing, so cron became the standing instruction. Run the submitter four times a day, automatically, forever. The timing is staggered 30 minutes after each scrape, so the dependent job always runs after the data it needs. A manual trigger rides alongside for testing. And the architecture doc began turning five separate features into one legible system. The rule this week, shipping a piece isn't the same as wiring it into a system. Your turn. Find a script you still run by hand and ask Claude to turn it into a standing instruction, a cron schedule with a manual trigger alongside for testing. Then ask the harder question.
